text_block_list.text:
A long time ago, I used to play café 
pretend with a friend. Suddenly recalling 
that, once again—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Damn it...! Can't find it... Can't deduce 
a damn thing...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Even this scenery. Everything's 
pissing me—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: !! Whoa, watch it!

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, big sis! I'm in a hurry, so 
bye-bye~!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief, nimble little brat—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
? ...Was there ever a café in a place like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
............ Whatever... might as well 
pump some caffeine into my system.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Welcome.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Cafe? Ah, you working part-time here or 
something? Wait...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The exterior was weird enough, but the 
interior is just as irregular, 
indeterminate...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, is my brain really incapable of 
tolerating even this level of 
fluctuation...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............ ...I will brew some coffee 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Latte art...? What's this, wasting 
time on crap like—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...This pattern... is it a fractal 
structure?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Swaying, rotating... damn. Endless, 
ordered, beautiful—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...The sea... ...Ah, that's right. I came 
out to the sea.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The wind and waves are gentle... however, 
it seems the weather will turn sour after 
this. What a pity... when it was such fine 
weather...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ............ Fine weather, huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Weather is just a phenomenon, nothing 
more. There's no good or bad to it. Not 
inherently.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's just humans arbitrarily carving out 
local segments of the Earth's system with 
their subjective minds and conceptualizing 
it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Indeed, there is no need... to 
force things into boxes... and carve them 
out...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Everything... is fine just as it is. 
Simply feeling, simply observing... is 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... All you gotta do is just observe. 
Stuff it into the box of perception, and 
facts get distorted—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
............ That's it...! Isn't that 
right... There's no damn need to interpret 
phenomena through subjective lenses.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hah! What do you know, once you realize 
it, it's so simple.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I await your next visit. Along with a 
cup crafted solely for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the 
shopping district, I spotted Air Shakur 
standing in a vacant lot.
choice_data_list: What are you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
! ...Ah, yeah... Nothing, just at the café 
right there...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Wait, this is an empty lot!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's... right. This place has 
always been a vacant lot... and I was just 
walking...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What the hell is this sensation.
